requirements: Never count source-only inspection as executed PASS.
Use actual public helpers and real Ed25519/JWKS verifier for lifecycle scenarios; mocks may replace HTTP transport only.
No paid calls. Use temporary per-test persistent stores.
Record SDK test name, exact command, exit status, assertions and commit for every case.
Supplement fixture sequence numbers monotonically per stream; ping remains sequence zero. Preserve signed call_id/tool_name/args bytes.
For unavoidable runtime limits record PARTIAL with reason, never PASS.
Frozen version2 bundle must not change. Additional edge-case tests may reference the existing45 IDs; they do not alter fixture provenance.

cases.name: Ordinary default
cases.acceptance: No extension request header; ordinary capabilities/messages/SSE succeed; foreground terminal closes helper.

cases.name: Native mode propagation
cases.acceptance: Exact native-tasks-v1 request token on capability preflight, admission, initial SSE, reconnect, lookup, cancellation and tool-output; legacy v2 native opt-in rejected.

cases.name: Native acknowledgment
cases.acceptance: Missing/wrong-case native ack fails before hydrate/dispatch; failed preflight causes zero POSTs; missing mutation ack yields unknown outcome with one POST, no retry.

cases.name: Foreground resolved replay
cases.acceptance: Fresh persistent store; request,result before ping; stable idempotent receipt for same running turn; zero handler effects and zero tool-output POSTs. Exercise actual high-level helper and real verifier.

cases.name: Foreground terminal replay
cases.acceptance: Fresh store; request,turn_terminal before ping; matching idempotent receipt; zero effects/submissions.

cases.name: Foreground pending replay
cases.acceptance: Fresh store; request before ping with no result/terminal; matching receipt; exactly one effect/submission, then matching result/terminal.

cases.name: Post-origin-terminal tool
cases.acceptance: Native stream origin turn terminal then task_request; exactly one verified handler effect and output POST to execution chat.

cases.name: Invalid inner signature
cases.acceptance: task_bad_signature invokes zero effects, zero submissions, surfaces verification failure.

cases.name: Repeated call
cases.acceptance: Same valid signed request twice: exactly one effect/submission; include fresh runner with same persistent store.

cases.name: Ownership change
cases.acceptance: Same signed call direct then wrapped, wrapped then direct, task1 then task2: never second effect; ownership conflict explicit or safe suppression recorded.

cases.name: Verification race
cases.acceptance: Pause real verification key fetch; observe task cancellation; unblock verification; zero effects/submissions.

cases.name: Active task cancellation
cases.acceptance: Task cancellation cooperatively interrupts pending handler and prevents late submission; origin turn terminal alone does not interrupt detached task.

cases.name: Deadline
cases.acceptance: Explicit finite overall operation deadline bounds capability negotiation plus polling/stream waiting; caller cancellation stops waiting; remote execution is not implicitly resubmitted/cancelled.

cases.name: Explicit errors
cases.acceptance: 401,403,404,409,422,429,502,503 retain typed status/error information; mutation network uncertainty never retries; classify-phase request_id unchanged.

cases.name: Array form values
cases.acceptance: Array-valued multipart upload fields preserve each element using exact server field encoding; include empty/single/multiple elements and actual shared captured-wire expectations.

cases.name: Update types
cases.acceptance: UpdateAgent/UpdateTeam model fields and optional omitted/null semantics match final canonical schema; compile/typecheck public request and response forms for each SDK.

cases.name: Page two
cases.acceptance: Traverse authoritative pagination metadata to page two on the configured API origin with authentication preserved and no duplicated base path. Implementations may use validated numeric current_page/last_page or validate/resolve same-origin absolute/relative links. A cross-origin next link must never receive credentials; reject it or ignore it when authoritative numeric traversal suffices. Test actual page-two wire request.

cases.name: Fresh delegated final
cases.acceptance: Target SSE live before admission, remain through initial acknowledgment terminal and signed task tool; return final origin output/result_turn_id, never receipt turn_id.

cases.name: Running duplicate
cases.acceptance: Exact event_id receipt retry for already-running job with pending signed tool replay: safely service pending call once and reach final origin output; no indefinite wait or silent lost request.

cases.name: Terminal duplicate
cases.acceptance: Exact event_id receipt retry for terminal job returns explicit final completed/failed/cancelled snapshot with no replayed tool effects.

cases.name: Unknown resident task
cases.acceptance: 404 task_unknown remains unknown outcome; no success/no claim of nonexecution; no delegation/classification resubmission.

cases.name: Terminal states
cases.acceptance: Failed/cancelled job outputs and errors preserved; delivery failed/cancelled status separate from job status; subtree cancellation wire boolean preserved.

cases.name: Request identity
cases.acceptance: Caller request-ID reaches intended request, response/error request-ID exposed without overwriting caller identity; reserved auth/contract/extension selectors cannot be overridden by custom headers.

cases.name: Structured transport errors
cases.acceptance: Typed errors preserve HTTP status, code, request identity and safe details across sync/async equivalents; no credentials appear in repr/log/error.

cases.name: Foreign execution chat
cases.acceptance: Foreign-chat event rejected before handler, submission or cursor mutation; wrapper execution chat retained; same-account target routing remains explicit.

cases.name: Bounded EOF
cases.acceptance: EOF/reconnect exhaustion during running job fails promptly with unknown outcome; no infinite wait or acknowledgment-as-success; pending waiter errors reach caller.

cases.name: Config/native DI
cases.acceptance: Custom headers and native opt-in survive every documented client configuration and dependency-injection path. Literal framework-specific integration may differ, equivalent config behavior must execute.

cases.name: Waiter error propagation
cases.acceptance: Stream failure, invalid signature, tool-output failure and task lookup failure are surfaced through integrated helper rather than hidden until timeout or converted to success.

cases.name: Durable restart
cases.acceptance: Restart runner/process with same durable store: prior call claims and terminal admission barriers prevent repeated effects; account/deployment scopes isolated.

cases.name: Runtime response validation
cases.acceptance: Malformed known request/result shapes fail before unsafe effects or false typed success, while documented additive fields remain compatible.

cases.name: valid Markdown/JSON/native builders compile same manifest
cases.acceptance: valid Markdown/JSON/native builders compile same manifest; absent/null/[]/{} cases preserved.

cases.name: local validation rejects badformat, emptybody, duplicate names, invalidmode/model(ifcatalog), unresolvedtools/agents, primary member/subagent orchestrator, max_tokens recursively.
cases.acceptance: local validation rejects badformat, emptybody, duplicate names, invalidmode/model(ifcatalog), unresolvedtools/agents, primary member/subagent orchestrator, max_tokens recursively.

cases.name: JCS/hash golden equality incl toolsets sorted, teamorder significant, Unicode/literal schema preservation.
cases.acceptance: JCS/hash golden equality incl toolsets sorted, teamorder significant, Unicode/literal schema preservation.

cases.name: all17golden plan/reconcile cases and deterministic operation/report identities.
cases.acceptance: all17golden plan/reconcile cases and deterministic operation/report identities.

cases.name: tool->agent->team create order and actual returnedID substitution
cases.acceptance: tool->agent->team create order and actual returnedID substitution; rerun unchanged writes0.

cases.name: rename agent/team keepsstoredID
cases.acceptance: rename agent/team keepsstoredID; toolrename createsnew and onlyprunesold with flag.

cases.name: adoption nooverwrite writes0/importsactual
cases.acceptance: adoption nooverwrite writes0/importsactual; adopt+overwrite updatesonce; conflict blocks allflags.

cases.name: managed-only prune reverse order, dependency failure surfaced, unmanaged resources untouched.
cases.acceptance: managed-only prune reverse order, dependency failure surfaced, unmanaged resources untouched.

cases.name: timeout-after-landed readbackequal success, timeout-before/different/unknown staysambiguous, no secondmutation
cases.acceptance: timeout-after-landed readbackequal success, timeout-before/different/unknown staysambiguous, no secondmutation; deletegone success.

cases.name: partialfailure preserves earliersuccess, stops furtherwrites, no ready
cases.acceptance: partialfailure preserves earliersuccess, stops furtherwrites, no ready; no fake rollback.

cases.name: lockreleased onsuccess/failure
cases.acceptance: lockreleased onsuccess/failure; concurrent processes serialized; crash/corruptfile cannot silently reset; accountscopes isolated; credentialrotation stable.

cases.name: durable file+DB roundtrip/restart, objectliteral shape, namespace and schema lifecycle
cases.acceptance: durable file+DB roundtrip/restart, objectliteral shape, namespace and schema lifecycle; DBrollback leaves nostate on failed transaction.

cases.name: readiness noimplicitnetwork
cases.acceptance: readiness noimplicitnetwork; partial/dryrun notready; catalogunavailable failclosed.

cases.name: CLI offline validate, plan JSON, dryrun0writes, drift exit2, status/state redaction, explicit destructiveflags.
cases.acceptance: CLI offline validate, plan JSON, dryrun0writes, drift exit2, status/state redaction, explicit destructiveflags.

cases.name: nativeSDK integration using existing typed/authenticated CRUD, no bypass of retries/auth/errorhandling
cases.acceptance: nativeSDK integration using existing typed/authenticated CRUD, no bypass of retries/auth/errorhandling; examples against mockremotes.
